subject: [PATCH 3/3] block: skip blkcg walk in blk_cgroup_congested() when nothing throttled

2026-08-12.patch_summary: This patch optimizes the blk_cgroup_congested() function by skipping unnecessary walks of the block cgroup (blkcg) ancestor chain when no tasks are being throttled. The optimization is achieved by introducing a global counter, blkcg_congested_blkcgs, which tracks the number of blkcgs with non-zero congestion counts. When this count is zero, the function returns immediately without performing the expensive walk. This change reduces overhead and improves performance on systems with deep container hierarchies.
